categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Tongxingbao Intelligent Transportation Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three business segments: smart transportation electronic toll collection (ETC) including ETC issuance and electronic toll services; smart transportation operation management systems involving software development, integrated solutions, and technical services; and smart transportation ecosystem services that leverage ETC user data to provide value-added services such as smart parking, supply chain services, and vehicle-related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including cloud computing, artificial intelligence, big data, Internet of Things (IoT), 5G communication, digital twin, and edge computing. It develops proprietary digital traffic cloud service products and integrates hardware and software solutions such as AI video analysis platforms, cloud-based tolling systems, intelligent roadside units, and vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication devices. The company also emphasizes system integration and software development maturity (CMMI Level 5).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government transportation management agencies, highway and bridge operating enterprises, traffic police and law enforcement units, automotive manufacturers for ETC pre-installation, and financial institutions. The company serves markets across highway tolling, urban traffic management, logistics supply chains, and smart city infrastructure, with a focus on digital transformation of transportation infrastructure and services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with ETC user coverage across all 31 provinces. It has significant market presence in Jiangsu province and expanding operations in other provinces such as Anhui, Zhejiang, Sichuan, Guangdong, Hunan, and Beijing. The company also pursues national-level projects and aims to expand its smart transportation solutions nationwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Tongxingbao operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the smart transportation supply chain, providing platform-based solutions, software, hardware, and services for toll collection, traffic management, and ecosystem applications. It collaborates with upstream automotive manufacturers for ETC pre-installation and downstream with end users and financial service providers for ecosystem services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation focusing on digital infrastructure transformation, urban vehicle-road-cloud integration, data element utilization, and overseas smart transportation development. R&D efforts target AI large models, intelligent tolling systems, V2X communication, digital twin simulations, and integrated cloud-edge-end platforms. It fosters industry-academia partnerships and emphasizes product innovation, technology upgrades, and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales (ETC devices and software), service fees from electronic toll collection and clearing, software development and system integration contracts, and ongoing technical service fees. The company also earns from ecosystem services including data services, supply chain collaboration, and value-added applications, with a direct sales model dominating.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's smart transportation sector, ranking second nationally in ETC user issuance. It holds a competitive edge through proprietary technologies, extensive user base, and comprehensive product offerings. Competitors include regional smart transportation solution providers and technology firms in the intelligent traffic and tolling industry. The company leverages strategic partnerships and continuous innovation to maintain and expand its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 895.5 million, a 20.75% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 209.7 million, up 9.81%. It has total assets exceeding RMB 5.5 billion and equity of RMB 2.7 billion. The company shows steady growth in revenue and profitability, with expanding R&D investment and increasing market penetration, especially in smart transportation operation management systems.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated smart transportation ecosystem combining ETC issuance, advanced cloud-based operation management, and data-driven ecosystem services. Its unique value lies in nationwide ETC user coverage, proprietary AI and cloud technologies, comprehensive product suites, and strong government and industry partnerships. It offers high-quality, scalable, and secure solutions that improve traffic efficiency, safety, and user experience, differentiating itself through innovation, service quality, and extensive industry expertise.
